compute_convex_iou: build a python module to compute intersection-over-union between point sets and polygons using convex_iou
compute_convex_giou: build a python module to compute generalized IoU between point sets and polygons using convex_giou
calculate_iou_for_detection: create a function that calculates IoU scores between convex hull point sets and quadrilateral polygons for 3D detection
